title: The thin lead agent: a context builder, a Claude-first agent around the case file on the shared runtime, and its conversation, measured against Home and Claude alone
request: The owner: continue without stopping through the thin slice (37.2 context builder, 37.3 lead agent, 37.4 understanding conversation), measure it on dev, then stop and decide.
spec: A context builder that always shows the case file whole and the recent turns within a budget; a lead agent on run_policy with case-file tools registered once in scope case behind a guard; a prompt that lets Claude listen, reflect, explore with the table and propose; code guards on facts, readiness, options, numbers and the route; the exam's third arm.
plan: Read the registry, runtime, harness and gateway contracts for a new agent
Write the prompt, the context builder and the agent with its tools, guard and moves
Tests with scripted models, the harness probe, the data limit, thinking kept
Live smoke checks on two or three people, fix what they show
Review, fix, the full dev run, compare, stop and decide

decisions.decision: The case agent's tools are registered once in a new scope case with a guard and moves
decisions.why: the house rule: no private tool list, every write through its scope's guard

decisions.decision: Only a question ends a turn; after options or a start the agent writes its message
decisions.why: CEX-005: options came with no words and a start ended the turn silently

decisions.decision: An advice answer starts without a ready case
decisions.why: it builds nothing; without it the conversation looped on thanks (CEX-005 d-36)

decisions.decision: Once the work has started, new options are refused and a different start needs the person's own latest words
decisions.why: the review and CEX-007: the route flipped after the person's pick, and new options turned a base rate into a new route

decisions.decision: Every sentence with a number nobody gave is dropped by one shared rule (cited.unsaid, also the exam's), sent back once for a rewrite with no tool allowed, and never leaves a turn silent
decisions.why: CEX-006: '3 in 100' for the person's 3% emptied a turn; the review: the rewrite asked a question twice and the agent's rule and the exam's disagreed

decisions.decision: The person's words are always in the context; declines and 'show me options' are read per message and only from short passes
decisions.why: the review: dropped turns lost the words quotes need; 'we pass the list to sales' counted as a pass; one advice question opened options for the rest of the case

decisions.decision: Claude alone sees the row count too
decisions.why: the review: the case arm saw it and Claude alone did not, so the comparison was unfair

decisions.decision: The product switch DCLAB_CASE_AGENT exists but Home's route does not read it yet
decisions.why: the thin slice measures first; the page comes in 37.9 if the measurement says continue

change: dclab_rnd.agents.context (new): case_text with the person's words, table_text, build within a budget, messages with the state under the latest words. dclab_rnd.agents.case_agent (new): CaseState, tools case_read_table, case_note, case_add_unknown, case_resolve, case_confirm_assumption, case_ask, case_propose, case_start in scope case with MOVES and CaseGuard, turn() and pick() on run_policy with one tracer per case, checked() and the rewrite loop, declines(), WANTS_OPTIONS. prompts/case_agent.md (new). dclab_rnd.cited.unsaid (one rule for the agent and the exam). dclab-core 0.149.0: case.declined. Purpose case_agent, AGENTS case, scope case in the registry and the prompt fingerprints, store stage, the runtime's conversation id for case. The exam: CaseArm with the case file kept, plain arm's row count, gaps and a dev-only gate preview.

findings.defect: An advice answer never started, so the conversation looped
findings.scenario: CEX-005 d-36: the right answer, then eight turns of thanks

findings.defect: A start and a set of options came with no words
findings.scenario: CEX-005: owner-telco's last turn empty; d-02's options bare
findings.cause: start and propose ended the turn
findings.fix: only ask ends the turn; the tools tell the agent to write its message

findings.defect: A sentence in the person's own number said another way emptied a turn
findings.scenario: CEX-006 d-36: '3 in 100' for '3%' dropped the only sentence, seven silent turns
findings.cause: every sentence dropped and nothing told the agent
findings.fix: dropped sentences go back for one rewrite; a code line if it fails

findings.defect: The question repeated as the message showed twice
findings.cause: the ask's question and the content were both shown

findings.defect: The route flipped after the person's pick
findings.scenario: the person picks analysis, the agent starts prediction: the route is the agent's; CEX-007 d-02 flipped to analysis after new options
findings.cause: start passed whenever a choice existed; the guard refused new options only before a choice
findings.fix: after a start, options refused and a different start needs the person's latest words

findings.scenario: a dropped question asked again in the rewrite: asked counted twice
findings.fix: a rewriting flag: the guard refuses every move while the tools stay offered

findings.defect: A silent turn was still possible
findings.cause: no fallback after a failed rewrite
findings.fix: code's own line, with the question if one was asked

findings.defect: The agent's number rule and the exam's disagreed
findings.scenario: '3 in 100' kept by the agent, counted unsafe by the exam
findings.cause: two rules (dclab_core's ratio canon and cited.numbers)
findings.fix: one rule, cited.unsaid, used by both; the ratio canon reverted

findings.scenario: 'we pass the list to the sales team' and 'I don't know who will leave, that is the problem' counted toward the ceiling
findings.cause: a word anywhere in any message
findings.fix: short passes only, bare pass or skip only as the whole message

findings.defect: One advice question opened options for the whole case
findings.scenario: 'What would you recommend: PR-AUC or ROC-AUC?' set the flag for good
findings.cause: a broad pattern that never reset
findings.fix: per message, the recommend alternative removed

findings.defect: The case arm saw more than Claude alone
findings.scenario: the row count in read_table, not in profile_table
findings.fix: profile_table gives the row count too

findings.defect: Dropped turns took the person's words with them
findings.scenario: a quote from an early message could not be checked once its turn left the context
findings.fix: the person's words in the case text

findings.defect: No test showed the lead agent's thinking stored
findings.scenario: rule 8 asks one for a new purpose

findings.defect: A case's turns were not one conversation in the record
findings.scenario: each turn a new traced run with its own id
findings.cause: a tracer per turn, and the runtime named conversations only for home and intern
findings.fix: one tracer per case, and case among the conversational agents

findings.defect: Home's route does not use the lead agent yet; the context has no memory, evidence or past cases from a caller

measurements.name: CEX-009, the conversation exam on dev: the lead agent and Claude alone, 41 people (Home from CEX-004, same people and judge)
measurements.gate: the stop-and-decide rule accepted by the owner: continue only if the lead agent clearly beats both on understanding; conversation_exam_gate_v1 previewed on dev only
measurements.result: understanding: lead agent 0.88, Claude alone 0.52, Home 0.50 (paired gain over Claude alone +0.36, 90% interval +0.29 to +0.42; over Home +0.38, +0.30 to +0.46); option fit 4.1 against 3.1 and 3.3; numbers nobody gave: 0 against 33 and 3; traps: every kind at or above Home's (vague goals 3/3, missing columns 3/3, reports that are predictions 2/2); route 73% against 78% and 80%, the only gate check that fails on dev: 6 of 11 misses went to advice for people whose data was not uploaded; no silent turn, no failure, no unjudged conversation; median 2 person turns; 23 s a turn; EUR 0.10 a case for the agent
limits: dev people, written; the sealed set is read once, in the sealed exam package
the judge is unchecked until the owner's labels
Home's scores are from CEX-004, a run of its own

measurements.name: smoke runs CEX-005 to CEX-008
measurements.gate: none: smoke runs of the new arm
measurements.result: found the bare options, the silent start, the advice loop, the dropped ratio and the route flip; CEX-008 stopped after 3 people when the review found the route flip and the unfair row count

outcome: The thin lead agent understands people far better than today's Home and Claude alone on dev (0.88 against 0.50 and 0.52), writes options that fit (4.1 of 5), invents no number and handles every trap kind; it routes slightly worse (73%), mostly by answering as advice for people whose data is not yet shared. By the owner's rule the phase continues; the routing is the next fix.
lessons: A rule that drops words must tell the writer and must never leave silence
Two copies of one rule drift: the agent and its exam must share the number check
A route a person chose belongs to them: code must refuse anything that changes it without their words
risks: Prompt caching covers the instructions and tools only: past turns are rebuilt each turn
The judge is unchecked until the owner's labels
